specification.objective: Recompose selected employee profile to emphasize identity before status and preserve existing actions and information.

requirements.statement: Present employee identity prominently before status and work mode in a responsive profile header inspired by the TouchIn reference.
Preserve employee data, status, work mode, actions, accessibility, light and dark themes and responsive behavior.
Persist the exact locked contract in docs/contracts/team-profile-rebuild-v1.polis.json.
Preserve the pending-adjustment indicator at 320 logical pixels and 200 percent text scaling without new indicator overflow.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A widget regression verifies selected employee name appears before status, including mobile layout and the edit action without exceptions.
Existing team tests and configured project gates pass and the stored contract equals the lock byte-for-byte.

At 320 pixels and 200 percent text scaling the pending-adjustment pill, icon and accessible label remain within its bounds without new layout errors; only the known mobile-header overflow is excluded.

invariants.statement: Do not alter APIs, employee data, authorization, navigation, actions or theme persistence.

forbidden_states.statement: Controls or content disappear, overflow or become inaccessible in supported responsive layouts.

inputs.statement: Existing team page, widget tests and supplied design reference.

outputs.statement: Responsive employee profile presentation and regression evidence.

failure_semantics.statement: The profile identity hierarchy regression fails on baseline geometry and passes after rebuilding.
